title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering and regional failover under thrashing
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering and regional failover. Fixes thrashing and incorrect circuit-breaker state transitions under rapid multi-region capacity fluctuations.
description: Context: in a recent incident we observed the SLO enforcer's backoff+regional-failover logic thrashing when multiple regions reported intermittent capacity pressure. Symptoms included repeated circuit-breaker opens/closes, cascading load-shedding, and several customer-facing 503 spikes. This PR implements a targeted hotfix: 1) stricter ordering and de-duplication for backoff timers (prevent concurrent shorter timers from preempting longer ones), 2) introduce hysteresis window when promoting regional failover to avoid flip-flops during transient pressure, 3) guard against races between the queue rebalancer and the SLO enforcer state machine, and 4) improved observability (metrics + traces) to show ordering and decisions.
commits: 1a3b7d2: core(slo-enforcer): serialize backoff timer updates and add compare-and-swap guard
4c9f2e1: runtime(cb): add hysteresis window for regional promotion and backoff smoothing
7e21a5d: runtime(rebalancer): add deferred-update to avoid racing with enforcer
9d4b6c3: observability: add slo_enforcer.backoff_ordering metric and debug traces
f0a8b11: tests: add unit + integration tests for ordering and regional failover paths
ff12e33: docs: add runbook note and postmortem link
diff_snippets: enforcer.go: added compare-and-swap around activeBackoffTimer updates (serialize updates to avoid preemption by short-lived timers)
manager.go: introduced promotionHysteresisMs config (default 3000ms) and smoothing factor for repeated promotions
rebalancer.go: changed immediate reassign -> deferredReassign with 200ms jitter to reduce simultaneous updates
testing_and_validation: Unit tests added covering backoff ordering and race scenarios (integration tests run locally and in CI)
Ran staged canary in us-west-2 + eu-west-1 for 24h under synthetic load pattern; no flip-flop observed
Load test: replayed incident traffic in perf lab with 4 regions and induced intermittent capacity loss; SLO enforcer held steady and failover promoted once per incident window
Observed new metrics: slo_enforcer.backoff_ordering (sampled event stream) and slo_enforcer.promotion_hysteresis_{region}
review_comments: Evan Thompson: Please add a unit test that simulates two backoff timers with different durations arriving concurrently — ensure longer timer wins. (addressed in f0a8b11)
Natalie Ruiz: Hysteresis default 3s seems reasonable but expose as flag for rapid tuning. (exposed via config and added runtime knob)
Marcus Li: Concern about rebalancer deferred update increasing steady-state latency — keep jitter small and bounded. (kept 200ms max and added metric rebalancer.deferred_update_ms)
Priya Menon (author): replied to reviewers describing reasoning, added tests, and noted where knobs are surfaced for on-call tuning
merge_outcome: Merged via squash on 2026-02-20 after approvals from reviewers. Backported to release/2026-02 as hotfix branch for Dedicated customers.
notes_for_oncall: If backoff_ordering metric shows >5 ordering violations/minute, increase promotionHysteresisMs to 5000ms and reduce rebalancer deferred jitter to 100ms
If customers report elevated 503s after deploy, rollback hotfix branch and notify SRE rotation
This change increases visibility — use slo_enforcer.backoff_ordering and slo_enforcer.promotion decisions in traces to debug
